exposure: Supplemental oxygen therapy (80% oxygen via Venturi mask)
Routine oxygen procedure (30% oxygen via regular mask)
cohort: The study included 122 women undergoing cesarean surgery at Besat hospital in Sannandaj.
finding: Supplemental oxygen therapy did not significantly reduce the incidence of wound infection but significantly reduced its severity 14 days after cesarean surgery.
mod_finding: The study's findings on supplemental oxygen therapy are specifically applicable to reducing wound infection severity following cesarean surgery.
